name: DNS Lookup
description: Look up records and compare responses and latency across custom DNS servers.

results.name: Name
results.empty: Every server returned the same records

hints.servers: Leave every server unselected to use the system resolvers; once presets or custom servers are chosen, only those servers are queried.
hints.presets: Presets come in five groups: primary, backup, TCP transport, encrypted DoT and encrypted DoH. Click a chip to toggle a server. Cloudflare, Google and AliDNS are selected by default so the first run already compares three resolvers.
hints.limit: At most {max} servers per query; {count} selected.

faq.a: A single failure does not fail the request; the error is recorded on that server's `error` field and shown as an error code on its tab.
The answer sets returned by every successful server are compared. When they differ, the summary lists which servers are missing a given record — common with CDN geolocation or DNS round-robin.

faq.q: What does the "All servers" tab show?
faq.a: It lists every server queried in this run — address, protocol, latency, status and a summary of its answers — so the results can be compared side by side.
Yes. Every answer carries its TTL in seconds, and the summary gives the TTL range across servers.

faq.q: May a custom server be an internal address?
faq.a: No. Custom servers go through the same egress guard, so private addresses are blocked.
